message: さっちんのラブラブ大作戦５

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wimp~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you seriously gonna say that just because I couldn't give him the present!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, you couldn't give it to him, could you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Augh」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan. Do you really wanna capture Synn-kun's heart~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know the answer to that better than anyone」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, yeah~. Still, you know better than anyone that just waiting around won't cut it, right~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You gotta use force~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Use force... You mean hit him!? Are you telling me to punch Synn!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa, easy there. That's not it~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If it's come to this, maybe you have no choice but to take Synn-kun's chastity by force~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-Wh-Wh-What are you thinking!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You might as well go as far as stealing his lips~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's a kiss!? Doing it by force is a bit...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, there's no way I could do that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're doing it~!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-My ears, my ears...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You have to do it~!!」
